messages:
Maya: FYI support escalation from customer 'nova-data' — their embeddings usage chart jumped ~4x after last night's analytics deploy. They say it's inflating 'units' in the dashboard vs expected vectors.
Rohan: can you paste their org id and a sample request id? I'll pull logs and the analytics events.
Maya: org=nova-data, sample_req=req-2026-03-17-4b7c
Priya: question 14 are they sending large batches or streaming single inputs? batch behavior often changes our unit math.
Maya: they reported batch_size=1200 in repro. snippet they provided: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model": "redwood-embed-v2", "inputs": [["doc1"], ["doc2"], ... 1200 items ...] }
```
Diego (Analytics): I checked the materialized view used for the UI. New code introduced on 2026-03-16 used this aggregation: 
```
SELECT SUM(e.token_sum * COALESCE(b.size,1)) as embed_units
FROM embed_events e
LEFT JOIN batch_meta b ON e.batch_hash = b.hash
WHERE e.org = 'nova-data' AND e.ts >= '2026-03-16';
```
Kira (Eng): token_sum is already the sum of tokens for the whole batch (we changed tokenization logic to pre-aggregate). Multiplying by b.size double counts. Should be using SUM(e.vector_count) or SUM(e.token_sum) but not both.
Rohan: also noticed a short window at 03:15 UTC where our ingestion service retried writes after a DB timeout; that produced repeated events for ~2 minutes. Combined with the bad aggregator it amplifies the spike.
Maya: customer is upset, asking for immediate credit and explanation. I told them we're investigating and paused any automated billing runs for their org.
Priya: short-term mitigation: disable the new materialized view and revert to the previous aggregator SQL. I'll queue a rollback.
DeployBot: rollback initiated for analytics-materialized-views v2026.03.16 at 2026-03-17T06:10:00Z
Diego (Analytics): rollback done. I'm launching a corrective backfill that recomputes embed_units using the right metric: SUM(e.vector_count) per org.
Kira (Eng): added ingestion dedup for the retry window and a check to drop duplicates where event_uuid already exists. Filing ENG ticket INF-792.
Rohan: repro script for internal validation: 
```
# reproduce counts locally
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-v2","inputs":[["a"],["b"],...]}'
# then query analytics: SELECT org, SUM(vector_count) FROM embed_events WHERE org='nova-data' GROUP BY org;
```
Maya: support ticket created, offered provisional credit; awaiting backfill totals before finalizing amount. Customer asked for confirmation when backfill completes.
Diego (Analytics): backfill started at 2026-03-17T06:35:00Z. Estimated duration ~90 minutes. Will post result ids when done.
Kira (Eng): root cause summary for postmortem: regression in analytics aggregator where token_sum (already batch-aggregated) was multiplied by batch size; second-order amplification due to ingestion retries creating duplicate events. Remediations: rollback, backfill correct counts, ingestion dedupe, add unit test preventing aggregation math regressions, and customer credit.
Maya: thanks all 14 I'll draft the customer-facing note and include the timeline and credit amount after backfill completes.
SupportBot: ticket SR-11243 updated: credit pending backfill.
Maya: closing loop for now, will reopen if backfill finds unexpected discrepancies.
